newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland mass privatisation unit sales hit 17.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Poland mass privatisation unit sales hit 17.4 mln.

text.p: Poland sold about 307,000 mass privatisation units last week, bringing the total number sold since the start of the sale in 1995 to about 17,366,000 units, the privatisation ministry said in a statement on Monday.
In the week ending August 24, 293,000 units were sold.
The units, which started trading on the Warsaw bourse on July 15, have been on sale since November 1995 and will be offered until November.
Under the National Investment Fund's (NFI) plan, each of Poland's 28 million adults can buy one unit for 20 zlotys, later to be exchanged for shares in each of the 15 NFIs.
The funds group more than 500 firms undergoing privatisation.
The National Securities Depository (KDPW) has so far transformed about 3.6 million of the certificates into paperless book-entry form, necessary for bourse trading.
